    }

  "rationale": "The set provides genuinely useful axes for the query: reason_category and duration_vs_dept_median are the strongest, giving new grouping/comparison leverage aligned with reasons, duration, and department. urgency_score and age_group_order are faithful but largely redundant numeric re-encodings of existing columns, offering only modeling convenience.
